provenance: computed with NumPy 2.5.4 and SciPy; parameterisations from the rethinking package documentation (dgampois, dbetabinom, dordlogit, dzipois, dstudent, dmvnorm2, dlkjcorr, HPDI, PI)

defaults.note: PI, HPDI and precis default to 89% intervals in the book

dlkjcorr_note: dlkjcorr(x, eta) is the LKJ density on a correlation matrix: use lkj.corr_cases of multilevel.json

waic.rule: WAIC = -2 (lppd - pWAIC), pWAIC = sum of per-observation variances (n - 1) of the log likelihood, std_err = sqrt(n var(pointwise)); deviance scale as in the book; confirm_with_R
waic.relation_to_loo: compare with psis_loo of multilevel.json: same log likelihood matrix construction

cases.note: Gaussian posterior: the quadratic approximation is exact

cases.model: posterior proportional to lambda^(a-1) exp(-b lambda) (Gamma(7.5, 1.6) kernel), lambda > 0
cases.scale: original (constrained) parameter scale, as quap does
cases.note: mode (a-1)/b; curvature -(a-1)/lambda^2 at the mode gives sd sqrt(a-1)/b

quap.rule: mode by optimisation, covariance = inverse of the negative Hessian of the log posterior at the mode, on the parameter scale written in the model (not the unconstrained scale), to match the book

standardize.rule: (x - mean) / sd with sd using n - 1, like R scale()
